cohort: SHA-256 identity-key ranks 2..3 per stable family, no fill

agreement.note: Exploratory agreement on a second, non-overlapping cohort; not a population reliability estimate.

decision_rule.T0_T1: not_identifiable: metadata identity alone does not establish remediation lineage
decision_rule.T2: identified iff post contains the remediation commit and pre excludes it
decision_rule.T3: identified iff at least one changed path exists post-release and its blob matches the remediation commit; otherwise not_identifiable
decision_rule.T4: identified iff every changed-path blob matches; conditional iff some but not all match; not_identifiable iff none match

limitations: The cohort contains 10 units because the 21.02 family had no rows after rank 1; no deterministic fill was used to avoid overlap with the first pilot.
Exact blob retention remains a source-evidence convenience signal, not semantic remediation truth.
No state is an affected/not_affected label or exploitability claim.
